description: Implemented GET /products endpoint with pagination and basic filtering. Started working on search query support.

Completed all API integrations for pipeline data. Fixed pagination on deal list. Drag-and-drop working. All tests passing. Submitted for review.
Completed the final 5 screens: settings, help, onboarding flow, and error states. Dark mode variants done. Exported all assets for developer handoff.
Implemented bidirectional sync logic with timestamp-based conflict resolution. Working on the Salesforce webhook handler.
Camera plugin working on Android emulator. Image capture, base64 conversion, and upload to storage all functional. iOS testing pending.
Finished module 3 (Password Security) and module 4 (Phishing Recognition). Running phishing simulation for Engineering team next week.
Completed email 5 (re-engagement). A/B test on subject lines showing 23% higher open rate on variant B. Scheduling final email for June 18.
Created 8 more LinkedIn posts including 2 video clips. Total: 48/60 posts completed. On track for June 25 deadline.
